verdict.rationale: Wave's first-party docs cover both halves of the story. Recurring invoices can switch between automatic and manual billing (wave-docs-10, wave-docs-24). Overdue reminders are sent automatically 3, 7, and 14 days after an invoice is due (wave-docs-2, wave-docs-25), though they are gated to the Pro plan (wave-supp-invoicing). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence that the reminder schedule or content can be customized beyond the fixed 3/7/14-day cadence.
